thread:
elena: Pushed a new mock for the billing header — added a topline balance bar above the spend chart to show "current balance vs forecast" and a compact token chip. Figured it's a better glanceable summary. Figma: <https://figma.com/s/3k2b-example|figma>
elena: Two UX questions: 1) When you toggle scope (Org vs Project) should the topline bar show project-only numbers or fall back to org totals if project has no data? 2) Copy for the invoice CTA: 'Download invoice' vs 'Download invoice (PDF)' — accessibility concerns too.
raj: My vote: show project-only when data exists, otherwise show a subtle fallback row that says "Org total (no project spend)" with a tooltip explaining why. Keeps expectations clear and avoids surprise jumps. :thumbsup:
marta: +1 on explicit fallback. Also, we should surface which scope the numbers came from somewhere in the header (tiny label) so it's obvious the bar changed because of scope, not a glitch.
tyler: Design note: we can use a muted pill for the scope source: e.g. "Viewing: Project (falls back to Org)". For the token chip, propose compact layout: "42.2k tokens" with denom in smaller text underneath. Avoid multi-line chips.
tyler: Quick a11y/code sample for the scope toggle focus/label:
```
<button aria-label="Scope switch: currently Project view. Press to switch to Organization view" aria-pressed="false">Project ▾</button>
```
tyler: Also thinking about contrast for the token chip — current gray-on-gray is ~3.2:1. Need to bump to >=4.5:1 for small text.
a11y-bot: Automated check: token chip contrast fails WCAG AA small text. Recommend darker foreground (#0f1720) or lighter background. Scope toggle needs `aria-pressed` and an accessible focus ring. Keyboard users must be able to toggle with Enter/Space. :warning:
sam: Backend note — we can add an `orgFallback` boolean and `scopeSource` enum to the billing summary API. That'll let frontend render explicit fallback UI without guessing. Minimal perf impact.
sam: Example response shape we can return (for clarity):
```
{ "summary": { "amount": 123.45, "tokens": 42200, "scopeSource": "project", "orgFallback": false } }
```
marta: On the invoice CTA copy — prefer the explicit "Download invoice (PDF)" for clarity when users expect a file. It's longer but reduces support questions. Maybe shorten the hover title instead of the button text? Thoughts?
elena: Hmm — I worry the extra parentheses add visual noise in compact headers. Could we keep button text "Download invoice" and add a tiny chevron or tooltip "PDF download"? That preserves brevity but signals file type.
raj: From telemetry, clicks on "Download invoice" are what we track. If we change text, update analytics event name so historical comparison still works.
elena: Good call. We'll keep button copy "Download invoice" + tooltip "PDF". Update analytics to `invoice_download_click_v2` if copy changes. :memo:
tyler: I'll darken the chip text and add the scope source pill. I'll also try a micro-interaction where the topline bar briefly shows "data from: Project" on hover. :sparkles:
a11y-bot: Reminder: tooltip must be accessible — role="tooltip" and aria-describedby/aria-controls linking to the button, and ensure it appears on keyboard focus too.
elena: Next steps — tyler to push updated mock with contrast fix, sam to add `scopeSource` + `orgFallback` to API, raj to update analytics event mapping, and marta to summarize copy decision in the PR. Quick sync 30m after mocks are up. Thanks all. :eyes:
_meta: This thread covers a design review on the billing header: behavior of a new topline balance bar when switching scope (org vs project), token chip contrast and layout, invoice CTA copy, accessibility flags, and backend telemetry changes. Short, iterative feedback and next steps.
